# FLX-3507: there is no sink by that name

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

A sink is named as NAME:TARGET, for example parquet:out/ or adbc:duckdb, and the name must be one this environment has: a sink the engine ships (parquet, arrow-ipc, adbc) or one a package registers under the flux_engine.sinks entry-point group. The message lists the names it found; fluxsim plugins lists them too, with the extra each one needs. Check the spelling, or install the package that provides the sink.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3507
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
